originalInput.name: Ceramic mug studio
originalInput.goal: Plan one month of mug sales, including a 60000-cent target surplus.

costs.description: Not a fixed monthly overhead: this amount is charged for every mug sold.
A combined flat monthly minimum plus a fee for each sale.
The ocean is blue and the trees are green.
A cardboard box and protective wrap for each mug sold.

ranking.name: Fixed / month
ranking.description: Fixed monthly overhead. The total bill stays the same each month regardless of how many units are sold or produced. Monthly rent, annual license spread over months, flat insurance premium, recurring flat subscription.

ranking.name: Variable / unit
ranking.description: Variable cost for each unit sold or produced. Total spending increases with every additional unit. Materials consumed per product, packaging for each item, per-sale transaction fees, piece-rate production labor.
